Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zugeo 0.0.0.9000

  • zugeo_info() reports the bundled geoarrow-c and nanoarrow versions and the GeoArrow specification version implemented.

  • geo_type_of() describes a GeoArrow field from its Arrow schema: every GeoArrow 0.2 extension name, both coordinate layouts, list and large_list offsets and the view storage types, with layout errors for what the specification forbids.

  • geo_crs() carries a coordinate reference system exactly as given, typed as GeoArrow asks, and geo_crs_equal() compares two at three levels without PROJ.

  • geo_vctr holds geometries in the Arrow arrays they were read in, as positions, so subsetting, rev() and c() copy no buffer. With zugeo loaded, zuarrow reads every GeoArrow column as one and writes it back with its extension metadata unchanged; format() gives WKT.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
